meta.name: sbti-skill
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "跑一下 SBTI 测试", "做 SBTI 人格测评", "score SBTI answers", "analyze this persona with SBTI", "看看 Claude 自己是什么 SBTI", "answer the SBTI questionnaire", or needs to use the bundled `sbti.md` questionnaire and `sbti_skill.py` scorer in this directory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成 SBTI 人格测评并获取分析结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要进行 SBTI 人格类型测试并解读结果。
copy.tagline_en: Complete the SBTI personality assessment and get analysis results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to take the SBTI personality test and interpret the results.

howto.what: Claude 会读取 SBTI 问卷，根据你的要求（指定人格、自己作答或测 Claude 自身）生成答案 JSON，然后运行评分脚本，输出最终类型、前三候选和维度总结，并给出简短解释。
howto.when: 当你提出“跑一下 SBTI 测试”、“做 SBTI 人格测评”、“score SBTI answers”、“analyze this persona with SBTI”、“看看 Claude 自己是什么 SBTI”、“answer the SBTI questionnaire”等请求时触发。

say.text: 跑一下 SBTI 测试，测测我的性格类型。
say.note: Claude 会按你的默认风格作答并评分。

say.text: 用 SBTI 分析一下这个角色：一个内向、喜欢思考的程序员。
say.note: Claude 会按你描述的角色作答并输出结果。

say.text: 看看 Claude 自己是什么 SBTI 类型。
say.note: Claude 会基于自身风格作答，并说明结果有主观性。

howto.what_en: Claude reads the SBTI questionnaire, generates answer JSON based on your request (specified persona, self-answer, or Claude's own style), runs the scoring script, and outputs the final type, top 3 candidates, dimension summaries, and a brief explanation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "run the SBTI test", "take the SBTI personality assessment", "score SBTI answers", "analyze this persona with SBTI", "see what SBTI type Claude is", "answer the SBTI questionnaire", or similar requests.

say_en.text: Run the SBTI test and tell me my personality type.
say_en.note: Claude will answer based on your default style and score it.

say_en.text: Analyze this persona with SBTI: an introverted, thoughtful programmer.
say_en.note: Claude will answer as that persona and output results.

say_en.text: What SBTI type is Claude itself?
say_en.note: Claude will answer based on its own style, noting subjectivity.
